modelDescription: Built as a versatile core hunting rifle, this model pairs modern ergonomics with rugged performance: a Savage exclusive camo stock with AccuFit V2, showcasing toolless LOP and comb adjustments plus interchangeable grip modules and M-Lok panels lets you tailor fit and accessory layout on the fly, while a fluted Cerakoted bolt body with a threaded bolt handle provide corrosion resistance and silky operation. The user-adjustable AccuTrigger delivers predictable, tunable breaks; Gun Metal Bronze Cerakoted stainless steel barrel in a heavy sporter contour with spiral fluting keep weight forward for steady tracking and a complete package built for your hunt. A threaded muzzle, one-piece 20 MOA rail for optics, and AICS magazine make the rifle ready for any setup, and the option of all calibers in left-hand configuration ensures equal performance for southpaw shooters.
